verdicts.reason: A keeps the headline dominant and groups the RSVP button with the body copy, but the date badge has shrunk to an unreadable sliver, the 'LISTENING SESSION' eyebrow has been demoted to a tiny tail at the end of the body line, and the headphones are pulled off their circle, which runs off the right edge. B is scattered: the body copy is jammed into the top-left corner before the headline, the CTA floats under the headline with no shared edge, the date badge is a tiny, illegible orphan in the middle, and the eyebrow is stuck on the cropped circle, with the headphones again off their circle.
